statement-coverage.claim: the trusted selection continues to execute the currently reviewed source cohort
statement-coverage.method: pytest-cov under the complete trusted selection
statement-coverage.response: inspect missing responsibilities; do not infer correctness from the percentage
statement-coverage.review_trigger: source cohort, test selection, coverage tool, or decision changes

flake-observation.decision: whether trusted evidence requires investigation before use
flake-observation.claim: a test has not produced both passing and failing outcomes under comparable conditions
flake-observation.population: test cases observed in up to 20 comparable complete trusted runs
flake-observation.denominator: distinct test cases with at least one comparable observation
flake-observation.method: count cases whose observed outcome set contains both passed and failed
flake-observation.response: fail health assessment and investigate; quarantine requires a separate owned record
flake-observation.review_trigger: evidence schema, comparability key, or outcome classification changes

cli-latency.decision: whether the packaged command retains an interactive response time
cli-latency.claim: a small assembled command invocation completes within the reviewed reference-project budget
cli-latency.population: seven measured subprocess invocations after two warmups
cli-latency.denominator: one source-environment CLI invocation with three short values
cli-latency.method: median monotonic wall-clock duration on the current environment
cli-latency.response: inspect environment comparability and profile the command before changing the budget
cli-latency.review_trigger: command workload, execution environment, timer, or user expectation changes
